name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single Janissary grenadier of the early 16th century, standing braced, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, late 20s, thick-set and broad-shouldered from carrying iron ordnance, weathered olive skin with old powder-burn scarring across the backs of both hands, a heavy black mustache with clean-shaven chin, dark hair cropped close beneath a white felt börk with a scorched brass kaşıklık holder and a singed plume. Wearing an ochre kaftan trimmed in blue at the collar and cuffs, a red sash wound twice around the waist supporting a bulky leather pouch fitted with individual pockets for cast-iron grenades, their fuses coiled and tucked. A short matchlock, its match cord smoldering faintly, is slung across one shoulder; a yatağan rides at his hip. Soot staining along the forearms and a leather apron guard over the chest. Expression wary and deliberate, the look of a man who handles fire for a living. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
